description: Buckets an actor's known ATT&CK-for-ICS TTPs into pre-impact (reconnaissance through command-and-control — the early-warning window before physical/process disruption) vs impact-stage (inhibit-response-function, impair-process-control, impact). Deterministic tactic-taxonomy lookup against intel.db — no LLM in the classification path. Price: $0.04 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].
